files.query.sql: SELECT id, total_cents FROM orders WHERE total_cents >= 5000 ORDER BY total_cents DESC;

SELECT o.id, c.name, o.total_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
ORDER BY o.id;

SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.total_cents) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC;
